test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The cyclone __have worsen__ the situation in Mumbai.
solution:
The correct answer is: **has worsened**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace** "have worsen" **with **"has worsened"** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Have **is used with the pronouns I, you, we, and they. **Has **is used with he, she, and it.</li&
